plugins.name: task-bar
plugins.description: A progress bar above the prompt for Claude's to-do list, and a Crew pane with a live card per subagent

plugins.name: fresh-start
plugins.description: Offers a handoff when a chat grows large, saves it in the project, then starts a fresh chat with it or copies it

plugins.name: cache-timer
plugins.description: Counts down above the prompt until the chat's prompt cache goes cold, with a Keep warm button

plugins.name: chat-ledger
plugins.description: A Ledger pane listing the connectors, files, skills, commands and context files this chat used

plugins.name: lesson-saver
plugins.description: Notices when you correct Claude and offers to save the fix as a rule in CLAUDE.md

plugins.name: prompt-shaper
plugins.description: Catches a long prompt, asks a few questions about gaps, and turns it into a clear brief in the prompt box

plugins.name: replay-theater
plugins.description: Step through the file edits Claude made in the last turn, one diff at a time

plugins.name: privacy-mask
plugins.description: Masks emails, phone numbers, amounts, IBANs, secrets and listed names on screen while you record

plugins.name: mod-switch
plugins.description: A Mods pane to turn every installed mod on or off, with named sets

plugins.name: ddev-guard
plugins.description: Runs PHP, Composer and vendor/bin commands through ddev exec in DDEV projects

plugins.name: repo-fence
plugins.description: Asks before Claude changes files or works outside the session's repository
